**[World Ferns](https://www.worldplants.de/world-ferns/ferns-and-lycophytes-list)** is a taxonomic database for ferns and lycophytes maintained by Michael Hassler, and contributed to the initial seeding of the PPG data.

To facilitate easy comparison between PPG and World Ferns (WF), the table below compares how the two treat taxa at the genus level and above.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## How to Use

By default, only taxa that are **treated differently** in WF and PPG are shown (for example, a genus placed in a different family, or accepted in one and not the other). Click **Show All Taxa** to see every genus and higher taxon; the button then changes to **Show Different Treatment Only**.

Columns ending in *(WF)* give the placement according to World Ferns, and those ending in *(PPG)* the placement according to PPG. Each column has a box under its heading; type to show only rows containing that text (case-insensitive). Filters combine.

- **Reset**: clear all column filters and return to the default view.
- **Download CSV**: download the rows currently shown (after filtering and sorting).

The versions of World Ferns and PPG that were compared are shown above the table.
